summary: Classification CSV file is used for importing and exporting tags of an **existing** classification.

headers.name: parent
headers.description: Fully qualified name of the parent tag. If the tag being created is at the root of the classification without any parent tag, leave this as empty.
examples: `""` or empty, if the tag is at the root of the classification.
`PII.Sensitive` as parent to create a tag `SSN` under it.

headers.name: name
headers.description: The name of the tag being created.

headers.name: description
headers.description: Description for the tag in Markdown format.
examples: `Personally identifiable information` as defined by the **Legal Team**.

headers.name: owner
headers.description: Owners as 'type:name' pairs, separated by ';'. Use the prefix 'team' for a team owner and 'user' for a user owner.

headers.name: tagStatus
headers.description: Status of the tag. Allowed values `Draft`, `In Review`, `Approved`, `Deprecated`, or `Rejected`.

headers.name: color
headers.description: Hex color code to customize the appearance of the tag in UI.

headers.name: iconURL
headers.description: URL to an icon image to display with the tag.

headers.name: domains
headers.description: Fully qualified names of the domains the tag belongs to, separated by ';'.

headers.name: mutuallyExclusive
headers.description: Set to `true` when the children tags under this tag are mutually exclusive, so an entity can be labelled with only one of them. Defaults to `false`.
